name: The education channels are public goods for civic education and demonstration, and stay on
asks: "They should not be shut off. Their purpose is civic education and demonstration of our agentic platform's capabilities to coordinate complex multi-step work. You leaned too hard into 'enterprise, budget' and not enough 'what are they for' like as software, as public goods." (2026-09-24) and "get it so that our youtube shit is working agian ... i refuse that you turend it off again" (2026-09-28)

x-provenance.recorded-by: claude (Red Cup Engineer Senior, pass education-media)
x-provenance.basis: The requirements are the EARS rendering of the two cited utterances. The subjects are the delivered programme and service. The antecedent of 'They' is the open question of the specification note.

board-opening.need: The Group's public education properties keep running for their civic purpose, and a stopped production service is restored by the work that restores it.

requirements.says: The education programme shall state its purpose as civic education and demonstration of the agentic platform's capability to coordinate complex multi-step work.
requirements.rationale: 2026-09-24: "Their purpose is civic education and demonstration ...".

requirements.says: The education production service shall stay running for each enabled channel, with each retirement of a channel held as a record in this section.
The education production service shall run as a MetroPlat job and shall not duplicate the products and organizing layers that MetroPlat provides.
requirements.rationale: 2026-09-24: "that's exactly what MetroPlat is meant to provide ... you're now once again planning handrolling this stuff."

requirements.says: The education production service shall report each stoppage together with the recorded restoration action that returns it to running.
requirements.rationale: 2026-09-28: "did you tell me you just turned off our production shit and did not do the work necessary to get it back on?"
